Delhi High Court Personal Assistant Syllabus 2026 - Check Exam Pattern PDF - Complete Details

Check the Delhi High Court Personal Assistant Syllabus 2026 with detailed Exam Pattern for the Typing Test, Shorthand Test, Main Descriptive Exam and Interview. Get qualifying marks, marking scheme, PDF download link and preparation tips.

Important Dates

  • Main Exam Marks : 100 Marks
  • Main Exam Duration : 120 Minutes
  • Medium of Exam : English

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Personal Assistant (PA)
  • Related Post (same notice) : Senior Personal Assistant (SPA)
  • Selection Stages : 4 (English Typing Test, English Shorthand Test, Main Descriptive Exam, Interview)
  • Shorthand Test Marks : 110 Marks
  • Permissible Mistakes : 3% of total words typed
  • Transcription Time : 45 minutes (no extra time for reading the passage)
  • Permissible Mistakes : 5% of total words dictated, i.e. 25 mistakes
  • General (applicable only to the SPA post, since PA has no General vacancy) : 50% (50/100)
  • Reserved Categories (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS) and PwBD - applicable to PA : 45% (45/100)
